implementation_notes: Records for data, `var` when the right-hand side is self-evident, text blocks and `Stream` used sparingly. Naming: methods are verbs, no `get` prefix on records, boolean accessors read as predicates (`isActive()`).
idiom_name: records + var where the RHS is self-evident
pitfalls: Long `if (a == null || a.isEmpty())` chains that could be `StringUtils.isBlank`
